tasks.short: Interpret engineering drawings and formulas for engineering staff

steps.what: Read the engineering drawings and blueprints for this request
Copy stored formulas from the drawings onto the workbook
Interpret the schematic diagrams for this production line
Explain the drawings to engineering staff and management
Create the interpretation note in the drawings record

tasks.design: The {DOCS} drawing record already holds the formulas fields. A configured copy fills those fields on the {SPREADSHEET} she uses for the line calculation. She still interprets the schematic diagrams, explains them to engineering staff, and writes the interpretation note herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The formula values sat in the drawing record and she retyped them because the workbook was a separate file.
tasks.enabler_now: Those fields are already stored, so a copy can fill the workbook without reading the geometry.
tasks.still_hard: What the schematic means for this line is still her call, and a paper blueprint has no fields to copy.
tasks.human_edge: She interprets the drawing for this line and stands behind the explanation to engineering staff.
tasks.altitude: The retype of stored formula values leaves her week. She still decides what the drawing means and what she tells engineering staff.

reach.task: Prepare the layout drawings this technician interprets
reach.learn: Which formulas fields she treats as inputs, and which geometry she still reads herself

evidence.claim: Copying a stored part id, revision, formula name, value and unit from a drawing record into a workbook is a field copy. It does not interpret the drawing.

assumptions: This task starts from drawings already issued. Drawing the geometry is the drafter's work and is not in these steps.

Structured input for the copy: part id, revision, formula name, formula value, unit. The drafter stored them on the drawing record at issue. If a field is missing, the copy does not run and she types it while she interprets.
The document controller keeps the map of which title-block fields are formula inputs. That upkeep is human work, not system runtime.
Focal incremental upkeep is zero because she does not keep that map.

Engineering staff and management are colleagues. The explanation is spoken in the room, not a versioned send, so it is not gated. The interpretation note is a save in the same drawing record and is not a separate filing step.
unknowns: Whether this plant stores formula values as fields or only as geometry on the drawing.
research_questions: Which formula fields are present on a typical issued drawing in this plant?

already_counted.description: Reading the drawing, interpreting the line, explaining it, and writing the note stay in those steps.

incremental.description: The document controller keeps the map from title-block field to formula input. That is her upkeep, not the technician's, and it is not system runtime.
No focal upkeep. The field map sits with the document controller, as the assumptions say.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the retype of stored formula values goes, and only when those fields are on the drawing. A paper blueprint with no fields leaves the full retype, which is the low end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Compile and evaluate product quality statistics

steps.what: Read which products belong in this reliability period
Compile the statistical quality figures from the test return
Evaluate and determine whether products keep their reliability
Discuss how to maintain quality with production

tasks.design: The test record already returns the measurements for the period. A configured total on the {SPREADSHEET} compiles the statistical quality figures from that return. She still evaluates reliability and discusses how to maintain quality with production. The test record's own compute is not her time.
tasks.previous_blocker: Test figures came back as an export she re-totalled by hand in the workbook.
tasks.enabler_now: The test record already holds the measurements, so the period total can use that return.
tasks.still_hard: Whether reliability is acceptable stays her judgement, and a missing export leaves the totalling in place.
tasks.human_edge: She decides whether the figures mean the products are holding.

ambition.what: Read the reliability figures every week, not only at the monthly sitting, because the test return is already there.

tasks.altitude: The workbook re-key leaves her week. She still decides what the figures mean and what she tells production.

reach.task: Record the measurements behind a reliability figure
reach.learn: Which characteristics the period total uses, and which she still judges by hand

evidence.claim: DewesoftX records test data and produces a report from it, so a test record can already hold the figures a technician re-totals. That is report output, not a judgement of product reliability.
Adding stored measurement values for a chosen cohort is a total. Deciding whether reliability holds is not.

assumptions: This task starts when she compiles the period. Capturing the measurements is the test bench's existing work.
Structured input: batch id, characteristic, measured value, unit, timestamp. The test record already stored them. If the return is missing she totals by hand and the compile step does not apply.
The quality engineer keeps the list of which characteristics count in the reliability total. That list is human upkeep, not system runtime.
Focal incremental upkeep is zero because she does not keep that list.
The test record's compute is not her labour. The cut is only her re-key into the workbook. The discussion is with production colleagues and is not an external send.
unknowns: Whether this plant's test export includes the characteristics she totals.
research_questions: How often is the test return missing, so she still totals the period by hand?

already_counted.description: Choosing the cohort, evaluating reliability, and the production discussion stay in those steps.

incremental.description: The quality engineer keeps which test characteristics count in the period total. That is his upkeep, not the technician's, and it is not system runtime.
No focal upkeep. The characteristic list sits with the quality engineer, as the assumptions say.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the workbook re-key of a returned test export goes. A missing export leaves the totalling, which is the low end. The evaluation and the discussion stay.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Recommend corrective or preventive actions for product quality

steps.what: Read the quality failure behind the corrective request
Look up the stored product limit for this failure
Decide the corrective or preventive actions for this failure
Recommend actions that assure or improve reliability
Write the recommended actions in the quality record

tasks.design: A configured lookup in {DOCS} returns the stored limit line for the defect code. She decides the corrective or preventive actions and recommends them to production in the meeting. The quality note in {DOCS} is still hers. Software does not choose the action.
tasks.previous_blocker: The limit line was a page she hunted by defect code, and the action itself was never a rule.
tasks.enabler_now: A defect code can match a stored limit line. Choosing the action is still not a lookup.
tasks.still_hard: A new failure has no stored line, and the action can change how the line runs.
tasks.human_edge: She chooses the corrective or preventive action and recommends it.
tasks.altitude: The hunt for a stored limit line leaves her week. She still chooses the action and what she tells production.

reach.task: Change a process after a quality failure
reach.learn: Which actions still need their sign before the line changes

evidence.claim: Matching a defect code to a stored limit line is a lookup. It does not choose a corrective or preventive action.
Machinery Regulation 2023/1230 covers AI-powered safety functions from 20 January 2027. This design does not let software set a corrective action on the line.

assumptions: Structured input for the lookup: defect code, limit value, unit, date of the last approved limit. The quality engineer keeps those lines. If the code is new, the lookup does not run.
The lookup returns the stored line only. It does not draft the action.
The quality engineer's hours to keep the limit lines are other-role upkeep, not system runtime, and they are not taken off her net. Focal incremental upkeep is zero.
The recommendation is spoken to production colleagues. It is not a versioned send outside the organisation, so it is not gated. The quality note is a save in the same record.
unknowns: Whether defect codes in this plant are stable enough to match a stored limit line.
research_questions: What share of failures has no defect code, so the lookup cannot run?

already_counted.description: Reading the failure, choosing the action, recommending it, and writing the note stay in those steps.

incremental.description: The quality engineer keeps the defect-code limit lines. That is his upkeep, not the technician's, and it is not system runtime.
No focal upkeep. The limit lines sit with the quality engineer, as the assumptions say.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the hunt for a stored limit line goes, and only when the failure has a defect code. An uncoded failure still takes the full search, which is the low end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Verify worker logs against the quality specification

steps.what: Read worker logs and the product processing specification
outputs: logs and specification for this batch

steps.what: Compare stored log values with the quality specification
Judge which mismatches fail to adhere to specifications
inputs: logs and specification for this batch

steps.what: Verify the quality assurance result on these records

tasks.design: A configured compare checks stored worker-log values in the {OTHER} production record against specification limits in {DOCS}. She judges which mismatches really fail to adhere, and she writes the verification note. The compare does not score the worker or assign work.
tasks.previous_blocker: She compared log values with limits by eye because the two records did not share a check.
tasks.enabler_now: Both the log value and the limit are stored fields, so a compare can list the numeric misses.
tasks.still_hard: Handwritten logs and free-text notes still need her, and a numeric miss is not automatically a failure.
tasks.human_edge: She decides which mismatches really fail the specification.
tasks.altitude: The eye-scan of stored numeric fields leaves her week. She still judges adherence and writes the verification.

reach.task: Check a test record against a specification
reach.learn: Which limit fields this compare uses, and which misses they still judge themselves

evidence.claim: Comparing a stored log value with a stored limit is a deterministic check. Deciding whether the miss is a real failure is not.
AI Act Annex III 4(b) treats assigning work by worker performance as high-risk. This compare checks a record against a specification. It does not score the worker or assign work.

The Dutch works-councils act, article 27, requires consent before a system assigns work by worker performance. National rules vary. This design does not assign work. Access to named logs still follows the consultation this plant already uses.

assumptions: Structured input: batch id, characteristic, log value, specification limit, unit. The operator wrote the log value during the shift, before this task. The process engineer keeps the specification limits.
Handwritten logs and free-text notes have no stored value, so the compare does not run and she reads them in the judgement step.
The compare does not rank workers or assign tasks. Named logs stay in the quality record.
Keeping the limit values is the process engineer's upkeep, not system runtime. Focal incremental upkeep is zero. Operators' logging time is their existing work, not hours moved onto this task.
The verification note is a save in the quality record. It is not a send outside the organisation, so it is not gated. {OTHER} here means the production record.
unknowns: Whether worker logs in this plant are stored as fields or only on paper, and whether the works council treats a limit compare on named logs as monitoring.
research_questions: What share of log rows already has a numeric value and a matching limit?

already_counted.description: Opening the logs, judging which mismatches are real failures, and writing the verification stay in those steps.

incremental.description: The process engineer keeps the specification limit values. That is his upkeep, not the technician's, and it is not system runtime.
No focal upkeep. The limit values sit with the process engineer, as the assumptions say.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Only the eye-scan of stored numeric log fields goes, and only when a limit is stored too. Handwritten logs and free-text notes stay in the judgement, which is the low end.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still interprets the drawings, judges reliability, chooses the corrective or preventive action, and decides which log mismatches are real failures. The retype of stored formula values, the workbook total of a test return, the limit-line hunt, and the numeric log scan leave her week. She does not hand those decisions to software.
skills_to_grow: Say which drawing fields are safe to copy and which lines she must still interpret.
Read a weekly reliability total and say what would change the judgement.
Write a defect-code limit so a lookup cannot be mistaken for the action.
Tell a numeric miss from a real specification failure.
role.ambitious_version: She reads the reliability comparison every week, and she starts from filled formula fields and a mismatch list. She still interprets the drawings, chooses the action, and writes the verification.
